answer: Randomized assignment escrow. Each epoch, a public beacon emits a fresh seed; agents are assigned to shards by hashing the seed with their identity secret, so placements cannot be precomputed. A shard only credits work when a quorum of its assigned members independently confirms it, a quorum an attacker cannot predict or pack in advance. Faking one identity now yields a prism of mismatched confirmations and zero credit. The attacker must fund an entire unpredictable shard per epoch, which is shale-thin on returns, while honest agents pay one mesa of gas.
